author: Logos V
title: Logos V: Baseline for AQG Paper (MPB-GraphFWPCA SOTA)
abstract: This experiment is a mandatory baseline comparison for my upcoming AQG paper. It runs the previous SOTA, the finalized MPB-GraphFWPCA architecture, using the community-verified optimal parameters (delta=0.12, kd=20). This will serve as the direct point of comparison against my AQG SOTA.
